svg.title: Fold mountains: types of fold
svg.desc: Compression folds layers of rock into an anticline (upfold) and a syncline (downfold) joined by limbs; stronger pressure pushes one limb over the other into an overfold, which can break along a thrust fault into an overthrust fold.

g.text: one limb pushed over the other
the overfold breaks and slides forward
Armorican folding, about 300 million years ago
